fields.notes: PSI5's protocol-level test surface is the loop-current sensing, the telegram CRC/parity, and time-slot occupancy. Chip-level JTAG / scan / BIST remain integrator concerns.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Loop current sensing
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: The ECU observes the modulated loop current; out-of-range current flags faults.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Telegram CRC / parity
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Per-telegram error check provides run-time observability of link integrity.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Time-slot occupancy
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: The ECU detects missing telegrams per time slot (synchronous mode).

extraction_hints: Look for scan / DFT / BIST / JTAG sections.
